label: Diagram 2.7
caption: Diagram 2.7 Fire resistance of areas near to external stairs
description:
This diagram, titled "Diagram 2.7 Fire resistance of areas near to external stairs," is a cross-section showing a stairway located outside a building. The stairway consists of flights and landings, starting from "Ground level."

The drawing specifies areas requiring "Fire resisting construction (minimum RE 30)," which is indicated by a green shaded area. This shaded region extends "9m below stair flights and landings," "1100mm above top landing," and "1800mm at side of stairway."

Within this green area, there is a "Fire resisting window (minimum RE 30)" located on the wall. There are two "Fd Fire doorset" symbols positioned on the side of the stairway structure. A door above the top landing is labeled "No fire resistance required for door."

A note at the top left states, "See para 2.17." A note on the left reads, "NOTE: 6m max. stair height without weather protection."
